ns2:course.label: Summer Band
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 289) Maintains the instrumentation of the standard band for the study and performance of all types of band literature. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of each course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public appearances by the band. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
